title: The Spooks' forebears
summary: Who the Spooks claim as founders.

claims.text: The Spooks trace their line to legends from before the Sundering, when no Shroud stood: heroes such as Odysseus, Orpheus, Gilgamesh and Aeneas, who crossed between life and death by plain physical means rather than possession or haunting.

In Greece and Rome, offerings to the dead and the Cult of the Heroes let Pathos seep into the Shadowlands; early Spook gangs gathered it, used what they needed and bottled the rest for other wraiths, which no law then forbade.

Armadar, from a Latin phrase for knighting, is the Spooks' title for a Defender judged efficient and ruthless enough for promotion; the rank turns on serving the Guild's Cause, not on a tally of kills.
An Armadar may take personal clients without Guild approval and leads a squad of Defenders.
